about: Exercise 1.10: sixteen crossings arrive as data -- requests, tool results, records at rest. There is no sender to correct them and no model to re-ask: the gate must give every crossing a named disposition (admit / repair / quarantine / reject), admit nothing invalid, lose nothing legitimate, and hold what only a decision can settle. Golds written before any gate ran; x-15 is formally perfect and wrong (the ceiling, planted).
